source.authority: https://fintraffic-vts.github.io/mnsw/location/locations.json (hub/EMSA mirror, spec 0027) + GISIS Maritime Security facility export (spec 0053)
source.note: Ours, not vendored. Every row states the evidence for its mapping; a row without evidence is a guess and does not belong here. relation decides what the door may do: not_a_code / port_area_of / renamed may substitute, confusable_with never does.

aliases.note: Mäntyluoto is a port area of Pori (FIPOR)
aliases.evidence: FIMTY carries no port areas, berths or facilities; FIPOR has area 'MÄNTYLUOTO' with facility FIPOR-0001 and 15 berths

aliases.note: Tahkoluoto is a port area of Pori (FIPOR)
aliases.evidence: FIPOR area 'TAHKOLUOTO', facility FIPOR-0002; the deep harbour is 0.4 km from the place

aliases.note: Vuosaari is a port area of Helsinki (FIHEL)
aliases.evidence: FIHEL areas 'Vuosaaren satama' and 'Vuosaari, telakka'; facility FIHEL-0030 'Vuosaari Berth A' 0.4 km away

aliases.note: Sunila is a port area of Kotka (FIKTK)
aliases.evidence: FIKTK areas 'SUNILA, SATAMA OY' and 'SUNILA, SUNILA OY'; facility FIKTK-0007 'HaminaKotka Sunila' 0.5 km away

aliases.note: Ajos is a port area of Kemi (FIKEM)
aliases.evidence: FIKEM area 'Ajos' with facility FIKEM-0001, 1.1 km away

aliases.note: Mustola is a port area of Lappeenranta (FILPP), on the Saimaa Canal
aliases.evidence: FILPP area 'Mustola' with facility FILPP-0002 'Lappeenranta Mustola (Saimaa Canal)', 0.9 km away

aliases.note: Koverhar is a port area of Hanko (FIHKO)
aliases.evidence: FIHKO area 'KOVERHAR' with facility FIHKO-0002; FIHKO-0020 is named 'Hanko Koverhar'

aliases.note: Vaskiluoto is Vaasa's harbour island (FIVAA)
aliases.evidence: FIWAS carries nothing; facility FIVAA-0001 'Vaasa Vaskiluoto' sits 0.3 km away

aliases.note: Valko is Loviisa's harbour (FILOV)
aliases.evidence: FILOV area 'Valko' with facility FILOV-0001, 0.6 km away

aliases.note: Röyttä is Tornio's harbour (FITOR)
aliases.evidence: FIROY carries nothing; facility FITOR-0001 'Tornio Röyttä' sits 1.3 km away

aliases.note: Puhos harbour belongs to Kitee (FIKTQ)
aliases.evidence: FIPUH carries nothing; facility FIKTQ-0001 'Kitee / Puhoksen satama' sits 0.3 km away

aliases.note: Ykspihlaja is Kokkola's cargo harbour (FIKOK)
aliases.evidence: FIYXP carries nothing; facility FIKOK-0003 'Kokkola Chemical and General Port' sits 0.9 km away

aliases.note: Rautaruukki is a port area of both Raahe (FIRAA) and Lappohja (FILAP) — say which works is meant
aliases.evidence: hub areas 'Rautaruukki' under FIRAA (FIRAA-0002) and under FILAP (FILAP-0001)

aliases.note: FIMTL is not a UN/LOCODE; Mäntyluoto is a port area of Pori (FIPOR)
aliases.evidence: absent from the 115,532-locode world set; seen in opsDesk as the call port of live Finnish port calls

aliases.note: FIVSO is not a UN/LOCODE; Veitsiluoto is FIVEI
aliases.evidence: absent from the world set; FIVEI 'Veitsiluoto' is operating (area Kemi/Veitsiluoto, facility FIVEI-0001)

aliases.note: FIRPI is not a UN/LOCODE; Reposaari is FIREP
aliases.evidence: absent from the world set; FIREP 'Reposaari' exists. Reposaari is not an ISPS port, so it keeps its own code rather than folding into Pori (user decision 2026-09-03)

aliases.note: FILLU is not a UN/LOCODE; Lapaluoto is a port area of Raahe (FIRAA)
aliases.evidence: absent from the world set; FIRAA area 'Lapaluoto' with facility FIRAA-0001, 0.8 km away

aliases.note: Raasepori's port is Tammisaari (Ekenäs) — FITAI. The 2009 municipal merger renamed the municipality; the port kept its name, so the code stands under the old one
aliases.evidence: FITAI 'Tammisaari (Ekenas)' with port-area facility FITAI-0001; the place sits at 59.979N 23.432E, Ekenäs town

aliases.note: The Porvoo anchorages belong to Sköldvik / Kilpilahti (FISKV), not to the town of Porvoo (FIPRV)
aliases.evidence: FISKV areas 'Inner Anchor place' and 'Outer Anchor place' plus facilities FISKV-0006/0007/0008, 3.8 km from the inner anchorage; FIPRV has no facilities at all

aliases.note: The Porvoo anchorages belong to Sköldvik / Kilpilahti (FISKV), not to the town of Porvoo (FIPRV)
aliases.evidence: FISKV area 'Outer Anchor place'; FIPRV 'Porvoo (Borgå)' publishes only 'Ankkurissa' and 'Ei Tiedossa' and no facilities

aliases.note: FIYPA is Ypäjä, an inland municipality with no harbour. If Yxpila — Kokkola's cargo harbour — was meant, that is FIKOK
aliases.evidence: seen in opsDesk on the row named 'Yxpila', whose coordinates are 0.9 km from facility FIKOK-0003

aliases.note: FILPA is Lapua, an inland town. If the Åland island Lappo was meant, it has no UN/LOCODE of its own — Brändö (FIBRA) is its parent municipality
aliases.evidence: seen in opsDesk on a row in the Åland archipelago cluster, 44 km from the nearest ISPS facility (Långnäs)
